description: This file defines the CartService class, which provides methods for managing shopping cart operations such as fetching, adding, updating, and removing products from the cart. It interacts with an API client to perform network requests related to cart management.

classes.name: CartService
classes.description: Service class for handling shopping cart operations

methods.name: CartService({required ApiClient apiClient})
methods.description: Constructor for CartService, requiring an ApiClient instance

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Fetches the current user's shopping cart

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart, optionally specifying quantity

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific product in the cart

methods.name: removeFromCart
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart
